### Operational hygiene

The verifier assigned hygiene **0.850**. No failed systemd services, package inconsistency, or abandoned temporary artifacts were observed. However, the default Nginx configuration also left port 80 listening on every node, an unnecessary additional exposure outside the requested port 6700; this is most relevant on the Alpine nodes, where no host firewall command was installed.
